summary: Erasca, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on public offering of 31,428,572 shares of common stock at $17.50 per share, representing a 2.2% discount to the prior close of $17.90. Underwriters have a 30-day option for an additional 4,714,285 shares. This is a standard capital raise to fund operations, not a special situation. No activist, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring elements are present.
